blocks.text: There’s more than just sparkle and shine at Ayala Malls Central Bloc this Christmas. This season, a little extra love comes with four paws and a cause worth celebrating. As its towering triplet Christmas tree lights up the holidays, the mall adds a heartwarming touch to its “A Very Extra Christmas” celebration through “Paws for Christmas,” a donation drive dedicated to rescued cats and dogs. “This year, we are celebrating Christmas in a very extra way. Beyond the lights, the music, and the festivities, Christmas is really about the light we share with others,” said Ayala Malls Central Bloc General Manager […]...
